item.title: Listening to off the map i found out im sorta subconsciously expecting the next section (starting at the faster tempo part) to be a repeat of another previous one. but it just Keeps Going n throws something new every danc time. is this intentional. or how much of the next verses have similar parts that im not picking up?? there must be some magic that keeps tricking me it's great
item.description:
6.1.26 3:48 am
Q: Listening to off the map i found out im sorta subconsciously expecting the next section (starting at the faster tempo part) to be a repeat of another previous one. but it just Keeps Going n throws something new every danc time. is this intentional. or how much of the next verses have similar parts that im not picking up?? there must be some magic that keeps tricking me it's great
A: "is this intentional?" when songwriting you really cant plan how it's gonna go, and if you do it gets very stifled. but i certainly dont mind that it does that. if you think "it's great" then i see nothing wrong here. i also must have thought it was good at some point too, because i kept it that way. Although, i would argue that what this song seems to do a lot, is refer back to words that have been used before, at the very least a couple seconds ago. Then there is one fairly big callback reference when it goes to "on the map". At that point, probably what happened is, the songwriter (me) started to realize, oh jeez this really has been very escapist (as you said), so i probably made a concentrated effort right there to recall at least what the name of the song was, and do something with that. in fact i believe i tried to also reflect that situation in the video at that point
